_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in a coil with no price breaker from dead ETF flows or crowded longs; HOLD is the graded base-rate call until a confirmed regime shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both stay non-aggressive and phase-adjacent (Anxiety/Complacency), but Narrative offers no explicit forward phase while Analyst calls Complacency HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with fear/greed inside 40-55 and etf_flows remaining near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear/greed breaks above 62 with ETF inflows and momentum turning up, or fear/greed drops through 39 with a funding flush and exchange-reserve dump
